name: Anthurium
description: Five-piece Long Island cover band that started in 2025 and plays 1990s and 2000s alternative, grunge and hard rock, from Alanis Morissette to Nirvana and Alice in Chains. It plays bars, street fairs and fundraisers, including 89 North in Patchogue and the Neighborhood Tavern in Farmingdale.

dancing.notes: A newer alt-rock and grunge cover band. Its daytime street-fair and fundraiser sets are more for listening; night shows in bars may get some freestyle dancing. We found no report of crowds dancing at its shows.
